title: HMA glacier reconstruction with five climate forcings: code

creators.name: Singh, Pawan
creators.affiliation: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, Mumbai, India

description: Model code (OGGM 1.6.3 preprocessing and temperature-index mass balance, volume-area scaling, per-glacier calibration to Hugonnet et al. 2021) and the analysis scripts that produce every table, figure and number of the manuscript 'Sensitivity of High Mountain Asia glacier mass balance reconstructions (1950-2025) to different climate forcings'. Data are in a separate Zenodo record.
